{{Quote|<nowiki>Eckhorn = died 20 years ago // Ship = exploded above Alderaan // Explosion = ruled accidental</nowiki>|T7-O1|<ref name="Eckhorn's List" />}}
During his [[Time/Legends|time]] as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] statesman, the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Eckhorn Baliss]] owned a personal '''ship''' that could carry at least one person. Baliss, who was actually a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]],<ref name="Eckhorn's List" /> put himself in danger when he added the [[Verre Sydia's husband|husband]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Verre Sydia]]<ref name="The Truth Comes Out">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|The Truth Comes Out}}</ref> to a list of potential Imperial sympathizers.<ref name="Eckhorn's List" />

Sydia's husband was an Imperial operative as well, though he and Baliss were not aware of each other, and fearing his cover had been blown, the Senator's husband<ref name="The Truth Comes Out" /> used classified [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] accounts to hire the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Terrin Sandafar]].<ref name="Terrin Sandafar">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Terrin Sandafar}}</ref> In [[3663 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Sandafar<ref name="Terrin Sandafar" /> placed explosives aboard Baliss' [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and detonated them when the noble was in orbit over his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] Baliss instantly. The event was ruled an accident,<ref name="Eckhorn's List" /> but was later discovered to be Sandafar's work by the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]].<ref name="Terrin Sandafar" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eckhorn Baliss and his ship are briefly mentioned in a series of conversations with the Jedi Knight companion character T7-O1 in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Eckhorn's List" />
